name: Giacomo Leopardi
contribution: An Italian philosopher, poet, essayist, and philologist.
legacy: His poetic and prose works explore themes of existential pessimism, materialism, human suffering, and the nature of happiness, which earned him recognition as a radical thinker.

checks.lead: Count Giacomo Taldegardo Francesco Salesio Saverio Pietro Leopardi (29 June 1798 – 14 June 1837) was an Italian philosopher, poet, essayist, and philologist.
